status.tqbf_oracle_relative_B2_counterexample: KNOWN THEOREM, previous LSPV-1 360, independently corroborated

system: Rmix341 unchanged (no SAT oracle). Finite checked proofs in ordinary source-explicit signed Resolution.
encoding: Strict one-clause-per-line ASCII DIMACS for finite controls; all-input theorem applies to binary or decimal header indices with at most N source literal occurrences.

machine_ledger.valid_oracle_SAT_decider: All-input parser, list of appearing variables only, polynomial-size TQBF query, one oracle call, malformed rejection.
machine_ledger.query_length: O(N log(N+2)) bits after occurring-variable rank renaming
machine_ledger.naive_header_expansion: For n=10^d and one unit x_n, N=O(d), emitting declared n quantifier tokens needs 2^{Omega(N)} time.
machine_ledger.all_phase_space: Query/source index materialization can use N polylog N writable bits; no rho<=1/2 guarantee.
machine_ledger.reference_space_envelope: s' <= max{rho,eta,lambda,lambda*s}; rho includes parsing, conversion, source access, query materialization, checking.
machine_ledger.oracle_external_cost: A TQBF query is an abstract oracle step; no ordinary polynomial-time SAT algorithm follows.
machine_ledger.proof_cost: Valid DP-produced pure RES certificates only. q=2/11/46 are upper bounds, not certified minima.
machine_ledger.offline_optimizer: Davis-Putnam resolution generation, truth enumeration and signed witness recovery measured separately, never imported into W_R.
